scope: Synthetic data aligned with the latest owner-relayed review; not real predictive validation or production approval

amount_policy.source: Owner review: whole soles or .50 are normal examples; exact product-price totals may be kept
amount_policy.generation: Draw the inherited truncated lognormal anchor, then with an explicit scenario probability of 0.75 quantize to nearest 0.50 with Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP; otherwise retain the exact two-decimal amount
amount_policy.mean_pen: Not owner-measured; typical S/20 remains a log-location assumption, not a proven mean
amount_policy.certainty: The 0.75/0.25 split is a scenario assumption, not owner-declared frequencies

payment_time_policy.future_or_simultaneous_payments: Never used as settled before evaluation
payment_time_policy.due_cutoff: 20:00 on the contractual due date; pending balance after that is late

client_pool_policy.weekly_distinct_recipients: About 9 and varying week to week
client_pool_policy.source_meaning: Customers can change week to week; 12 is a finite example roster, not population knowledge
client_pool_policy.rotation: Inherited 3-group rotation with 9 weekly scheduled examples; never pooled as simultaneous branches

pending_balance_policy.applies_to: Any positive remaining principal, including current debt not yet due
pending_balance_policy.after_settlement: Eligibility for evaluation resumes; no automatic approval
pending_balance_policy.historical_overdue_rule_superseded: Yes, for eligibility scope; original overdue clarification retained as source history

simulation.population_interpretation: Finite example roster per history, not a real fixed population
simulation.schedule: Rotate an absent group of 3 among 12 example clients each week; the inherited calendar is a scenario assumption, not a measurement of real traffic
simulation.amount_distribution: Inherited truncated lognormal with S/20 log-location, then the amount_policy above
simulation.latent_lateness: Inherited Beta heterogeneity, an explicit unmeasured hypothesis
simulation.partial_payment_probability: 10/48, an assumption from the owner-reviewed denominator
simulation.late_delay_distribution: Inherited truncated lognormal rounded to integers 1..15; shape unmeasured
simulation.payments: Every generated credit has a planned complete payment possibly after cutoff; permanent loss rate unknown and not invented
simulation.sales: Only linked granted-credit sales are modeled; cash-sale volume not quantified
simulation.unknowns: Population, distribution shapes, warmup length, stationarity, time distributions, and exact weekly frequencies remain assumptions

audit_before_any_model: No granted credit has any pending balance at evaluation, including current debt
No partial payment or agreement bypasses the pending-balance block
Settlement payments are observed strictly before evaluation; simultaneous timestamps do not clear
Snapshots contain observed events only and no future plans
Amounts respect 5..50 PEN, whole/.50 amounts are an explicit scenario policy, and exposure is at most 80 PEN
Payment times fall in 08:00-12:00 or 16:00-20:00; payments after the due date are late
Requests and grants are reported separately by complete week
All development candidates report losses, scale deviations, and unknown labels even if unfavorable
No reseeding, forcing approvals, labels, distribution shapes, or payment schedules to improve metrics
scale_acceptance: Owner confirms 12/9 is usual but variable. V5 review showed 8/7 possible; frequencies remain unmeasured. No numerical tolerance is predeclared as owner-confirmed.
publication: Local data revision only; no production changes, no deployment, no replacement of frozen evidence
